scope: CombatAtlas martial-art/drill expansion sources; legal-rights screen, robots/API screen, provenance requirements, and first lawful sample scrapes only.

sources.name: Wikipedia MediaWiki Action API: Category:Martial arts techniques
sources.license: Wikipedia article text is CC BY-SA 4.0 / compatible free license via Wikimedia terms; collected category titles are factual names, but copied summaries require attribution and share-alike compliance.
sources.robotsOrTerms: Wikimedia APIs are open access; Action API etiquette requires meaningful User-Agent, serial requests, grouping, gzip, caching, maxlag/backoff for non-interactive jobs.
doNotCollect: bulk copied article text without attribution model
instructional prose presented as proprietary CombatAtlas copy

sources.name: Wikidata entities and aliases for martial arts/techniques
sources.license: CC0 for main/property/lexeme structured data; other namespaces may be CC BY-SA 4.0.
sources.robotsOrTerms: Use Wikimedia API etiquette: meaningful User-Agent, serial/grouped requests, cache results, respect rate limits.
doNotCollect: non-CC0 text from non-data namespaces unless separately attributed

sources.name: Wikimedia Commons files for martial arts media
sources.license: Per-file licenses vary; Commons reuse guidance requires license-specific attribution and compliance.
sources.robotsOrTerms: Use Wikimedia API etiquette and file extmetadata. Store author, license, license URL, file page URL, and source image URL.

sources.name: Wiktenauer HEMA MediaWiki
sources.license: Default original Wiktenauer content is CC BY-SA 4.0, but individual source tables include public domain, CC BY, CC BY-SA, CC BY-NC-SA, orphan, uncertain, and mixed statuses.
sources.robotsOrTerms: robots.txt allowed general crawling and API probing in this run; content signals allow search/reference use, reserve ai-train=no. Must inspect each page/source table before reuse.
allowedUse: public-domain or CC BY/CC BY-SA transcriptions with attribution
doNotCollect: CC BY-NC-SA content for commercial product

sources.name: ubershmekel/bjjdata
sources.license: MIT per repository README/LICENSE; YouTube videos are linked only and not copied.
sources.robotsOrTerms: GitHub Pages robots.txt returned 404; low-volume JSON fetch succeeded. Prefer repository clone/raw GitHub API for reproducible imports.
doNotCollect: transcripts/descriptions from YouTube unless separately licensed

sources.name: Project Gutenberg public-domain sports/fencing/boxing manuals
sources.license: Most Project Gutenberg eBooks are public domain in the United States; site terms/trademark license still apply and non-US reuse needs separate copyright check.
sources.robotsOrTerms: Main site terms say human users only; automated bulk access should use mirrors/offline catalogs/feeds, proper User-Agent, and avoid >100 books/day. robots disallows /ebooks/search.
allowedUse: public-domain text from specific eBook landing pages
doNotCollect: bulk scrape of live search pages
Project Gutenberg trademark branding in commercial product without terms review

candidateItems.title: Practical Training for Running, Walking, Rowing, Wrestling, Boxing, Jumping, and All Kinds of Athletic Feats

sources.name: Library of Congress public-domain/no-known-restrictions martial arts and combat manuals/media
sources.license: Item-level Rights & Access controls; public domain/no-known-restrictions items may be freely used, but users must determine rights and respect privacy/publicity/trademark issues.
sources.robotsOrTerms: robots.txt allows item/API paths but disallows /search and sets Crawl-Delay: 5. Use loc.gov JSON/item endpoints and cache.
allowedUse: public-domain images/PDFs/text where Rights & Access permits

sources.name: Kaggle Grappling Techniques dataset by liiucbs
sources.license: Apache 2.0 shown in Kaggle search result; page fetch failed in this environment, so verify in Kaggle UI/API before import.
sources.robotsOrTerms: Requires Kaggle account/API token and compliance with Kaggle dataset terms. Do not scrape behind login; use official kaggle datasets download after license confirmation.
allowedUse: technique type/position/martial art fields after official API license verification
doNotCollect: any content behind login by HTML scraping
records before Apache 2.0 is verified from authenticated Kaggle metadata

sources.name: ViCoS Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Positions Dataset
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0; non-commercial and share-alike restrictions make it unsuitable for default commercial/product seed data.
sources.robotsOrTerms: robots.txt did not block, but license is the limiting factor.
doNotCollect: derived product data for commercial app

validationRules: Every imported record must have sourceUrl, source name, license, retrievedAtUtc, and sourceRecordId/pageid/qid when available.
Never set verified=true on CombatAtlas generated drills unless at least one allowed source backs the technique taxonomy and a human/instructor safety review has passed.
Do not copy copyrighted instructional prose from gyms, federation sites, YouTube descriptions, or modern manuals without explicit permission.
For CC BY-SA sources, keep imported text separate or make attribution/share-alike obligations explicit before shipping copied text.
For media, require author, license URL, file page URL, and local attribution display before showing assets.
